hooks.command: python3 -c "import json,os,sys,subprocess; d=json.loads(os.environ.get('TOOL_INPUT','{}')); f=d.get('file_path',''); f and f.endswith('.py') and os.path.isfile(f) and (subprocess.run(['ruff','format','--quiet',f],capture_output=True), subprocess.run(['ruff','check','--fix','--quiet',f],capture_output=True))"
bash -c 'if echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -q "docs/specs/"; then echo "BLOCKED: Spec files are read-only during implementation. Discuss changes with user first."; exit 1; fi'
